description: Replay every delivery attempt for this webhook endpoint that landed in [from_ts, to_ts). Returns `{ replayed, skipped }` counts. Use to recover after a downstream outage — every event in the window is re-fired.

from_ts.description: ISO-8601 lower bound (inclusive) of the time window to replay.

to_ts.description: ISO-8601 upper bound (exclusive) of the time window to replay.

name: bulk_replay_webhook
title: Bulk Replay Webhook
